_comment: Search partitions for discovery. Two things matter here and both were
learned the hard way from eBay's API behaviour:
1. buyingOptions is set explicitly on every partition. Browse returns
FIXED_PRICE only by default, so omitting it silently produces a
Buy-It-Now-only dataset - the exact bias this tool measures.
2. categoryIds is deliberately EMPTY and should stay that way. It
narrows the Browse search, and every allow-list we built was too
narrow: the 22 sovereign-named leaves dropped 2,491 genuine
Australian Sydney half-sovereigns, and the whole Coins subtree
dropped them too, because world coins hang off a different root
on EBAY_GB. Filtering is done instead on the category ANCESTRY,
which every search result already carries - see
